verdict.rationale: Mollie documents and hosts an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.mollie.com/mcp, confirmed live via a probe showing proper OAuth-gated JSON-RPC initialization per the MCP authorization spec, with documented client setup for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code and scoped access tokens covering many Mollie APIs. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on usage report confirming real-world agent workflows beyond the vendor docs and probes.
